class.name: FoliageBender3D
class.brief_description: Pushes grass and plants aside where it is.
class.description: Put one on a player, an animal or each wheel of a car: [FoliageMaterial]'s plants within [member radius] bend away from it and are pressed down, so a path opens through a meadow as something walks through it. Only plants growing about level with it bend, not those on a floor above or below. The 16 benders nearest the camera count; further ones don't bend anything. They reach shaders as the [code]foliage_benders[/code] shader global, two texels each: the first holds the bender's position and radius, the second its strength.

members.member: How far round it plants bend, in meters.
How hard it pushes, from [code]0[/code] to [code]2[/code]: [code]1[/code] bends plants right over at its middle.
